description:
The CLI supports `--official` mode for TPC-compliant benchmark runs which:
1. Validates scale factors against TPC-allowed values (1, 10, 30, 100, etc.)
2. Requires seed for reproducibility
3. Warns about multi-stream requirements
4. Displays compliance banner

This mode is not exposed in the interactive wizard, preventing users from
running official TPC-compliant benchmarks interactively.
